items.question: How can I contact Leafly?
items.answer: You can reach us anytime at hello@leafly.com — for order questions, product/delivery questions, or tea guidance, we'd love to hear from you.

items.question: What makes Leafly tea different? Tell me about Leafly. What is Leafly? Who are you? What's your story?
items.answer: We use whole, unbroken leaves for pure flavor, source single-origin teas with a clear story, follow ethical and sustainable sourcing practices, and blend everything in small batches for freshness.

items.question: Do you offer corporate or bulk gifting?
items.answer: Yes — we work with teams and businesses on corporate gifting, wedding favours, and client milestones, including custom sleeve/logo imprinting, discounted volume pricing for 25+ units, and multi-address delivery with tracking. Reach out via our Gifting page or hello@leafly.com.

items.question: What tea collections do you offer?
items.answer: We offer four core collections: Green Tea (fresh & delicate), White Tea (pure & delicate), Black Tea (rich & bold), and Oolong Tea (complex & refined) — plus curated gift hampers.

items.question: What sizes are available?
items.answer: Most teas are available in 100g and 250g sizes.

items.question: Do you have low-caffeine or caffeine-free options?
items.answer: Yes — each tea is labeled with its caffeine level (high, medium, or low) so you can choose based on your preference. Our white teas tend to be lowest in caffeine.
